title: Your electricity bill
key_sentences: We will collect this amount by Direct Debit on or after 20 October 2026, so you do not need to do anything.
Your estimated annual consumption is 3,640 kWh, based on your readings over the last twelve months.
If your night reading looks wrong, send us a photo of your meter within 14 days and we will reissue the bill.
As a member-owned co-operative, any surplus we make is returned to members or invested in local renewable energy.

list_items.text: Run your washing machine and dishwasher after 22:00, when night units are cheaper.
Members can join the community solar share scheme from 1 January.
Ask us for a free home energy check if your usage has risen by more than 10%.

furniture: Brightwater Energy Co-operative Ltd is a registered society, number 31877R.
notes: Household electricity bill from a co-operative, one page. Two boxes SIDE BY SIDE: "Account summary" (left, key/value table, no header row) then "Meter readings" (right, small table with header row plus a legend line); read left box then right box. Charges table is zebra-striped, with subtotal, VAT and total rows whose label spans three columns (repeated). Minus sign U+2212 in credits. Ways-to-save list is CSS-drawn. Customer address lines and the bill reference line are body text, not headings.
